terms.definition: An individual or legal entity registered to purchase goods and services from the fiction-retail platform.
A commercial agreement transaction representing an item purchase placed by a customer.
A commercial merchandise item SKU listed in the retail catalog for purchase.
Monetary value generated from customer purchases before applicable deductions.
Total gross revenue minus applicable promotional discounts, refunds, and coupons.
Total undiscounted monetary value of ordered quantity multiplied by purchase unit price.
Cumulative net monetary value realized or predicted from a customer across their entire relationship lifespan.
The current fulfillment and processing lifecycle state of a customer transaction order.
Financial settlement processing state of a payment tender charge transaction.
A physical or digital retail outlet location where customer order fulfillment originates.
